manifest_row.title: How Trump Appointees Short-Circuited Grid Modernization

screening.main_topic: Political interference in a U.S. national-laboratory study of grid connections that could expand renewable energy and reduce coal use.
screening.climate_relevance: The article repeatedly connects transmission upgrades and renewable-energy deployment to reduced carbon emissions and slowing climate change, and examines how political efforts to protect coal affected research and climate-mitigation policy.
screening.reason: Climate change and its mitigation are central to the article’s account of the Seams study, which modeled how a more interconnected grid could support wind and solar power, reduce fossil-fuel use, and cut CO2 emissions. The article also discusses the political suppression of findings with implications for climate action.
